maya (AE): Hey team — customer asking for a BYOK flow with HSM-backed keys for our Private deployment. They want a presales sketch + any required artifacts. Can we confirm supported modes and an ask list?
ashwin (SEC): We support BYOK via customer-wrapped keys and direct KMS integration. For HSM-backed keys we accept EK/KEK wrapped material from AWS CloudHSM, AWS KMS HSM (external key store), and Azure Dedicated HSM. Need details on network egress and key import process.
maya (AE): Customer also said they need key rotation every 90 days, audit trail to their SIEM, and FIPS 140-2 evidence. Is that feasible?
ashwin (SEC): Rotation: we can rotate model-serving data keys on customer schedule. Two options: (1) Customer-managed KMS rotates KEK and sends new wrapped DEKs; (2) We rotate locally but require customer-approved rotation window + audit hooks. For SIEM, we can emit key events via syslog/forwarder to their collector. FIPS 140-2: we can provide attestation docs for our recommended HSM partners; for hosted we have third-party cert matrix.
carol (SRE): For Private (VPC) installs we need a handshake: 1) customer creates HSM/KMS key, 2) exports public wrapping material or sets up external key store trust, 3) we perform import via offline signed bundle or over TLS mutual-auth. Network: we require an outbound-only control plane callback to validate key ownership unless air-gapped. If air-gapped, we do an offline import procedure.
pablo (SE): TL;DR for presales slide: supported patterns = KMS-managed KEK (AWS/Azure/GCP), HSM-wrapped import (CloudHSM/Azure HSM), and client-side encrypted payloads (you keep DEKs). I'll attach a short diagram in the POC packet.
maya (AE): Customer asked about cost delta and latency impact when using HSM vs our default encryption. Any numbers?
pablo (SE): HSM-wrapped key ops add a small constant for key unwrap on workload startup and rotation events only — per-request latency unaffected because we cache DEKs in memory with TTL. Expect +50–150ms during rotation/initialization depending on network. Cost: licensing + HSM admin + egress for external key calls. I'll pull expected ranges for their scale.
nashwin (SEC): For the security questionnaire: require the SIG/CAIQ snippets: KMS control mapping, key lifecycle policy, rotation SLAs, and evidence links (HSM certs). I can draft suggested language: 1) "All customer key material may be kept under customer control via BYOK/HSM. Redwood supports import and integration with external KMS/HSMs and provides auditable key-use logs." 2) "Rotation frequency is configurable; Redwood can accommodate customer rotations and produce rotation event logs."
maya (AE): Can you also confirm whether customers need to share raw key material with us? They explicitly asked not to.
nashwin (SEC): We never require plaintext key export. Options: key-wrapping (customer wraps DEKs with KEK and sends wrapped blobs), external EKM where calls are proxied to customer KMS, or client-side encryption where they keep plaintext keys entirely. We'll include that as presales bullet points.
carol (SRE): Practical POC tasks: - Provide sample import script (for offline bundle) - Walkthrough of mutual TLS setup for KMS proxy - Example of rotation runbook and audit output (json syslog) - Short latency test to show unwrap time impact. I can prepare the runbook and sample logs.
maya (AE): Perfect. For the POC timeline customer wants a 2-week eval. Can we scope required artifacts we need from them?
pablo (SE): Ask list: 1) Which HSM/KMS vendor and whether EKM/external key store will be used; 2) Admin contact + PKI for mTLS; 3) Desired rotation cadence; 4) SIEM endpoint (syslog/HTTPS); 5) Any required compliance artifacts (attestation/cert copy).
nashwin (SEC): I'll draft the SIG-friendly text and a short QA doc answering: "Do you have to hand over keys?" "What audit trails exist?" "How does rotation work?" and include citations to our partner HSM cert pages.
maya (AE): Great — can we get those artifacts by EOD tomorrow? I'll tell the customer the POC kickoff is dependent on those items.
sec-bot: SR-4567 created for POC onboarding checklist. Link: https://redwood.example/sr/4567
maya (AE): Thanks all — once we have the draft SIG wording and the runbook I'll upload to the customer's presales portal and schedule the kickoff.
carol (SRE): I uploaded a skeleton runbook to the presales drive: https://drive.redwood/poctemplates/kms-handshake.md — contains import script and example logs. Will fill in details by tomorrow morning.
nashwin (SEC): Draft SIG snippets posted in the security wiki: https://wiki.redwood/security/sig-snippets#kms. I'll refine language for the CAIQ controls.
maya (AE): Awesome. Closing loop with customer now. :thumbsup:
